items.title: Flowing Water
items.content_html:
One laugh, one fool, one madness,

Half dreaming, half awake, half a face of sorrow.

Branches sway and swing, the branch unseen,

Blossoms bloom and fall, without a pause.

Introduction

Written around mid-November 2018.

items.title: 流水
items.content_html:
一笑一傻一疯癫，

半梦半醒半愁颜。

枝摇枝摆枝不现，

花开花落花无间。

介绍

写于2018年11月中旬左右。

items.title: 尘缘
items.content_html:
一场繁绕一场分，

佛不渡我我渡尘。

三分不见七分痕，

寸草忧来寸草闻。

介绍

写于2018年7月初。

都说六月的雨，写满伤感。我曾不懂……

items.title: Dust of Fate
items.content_html:
One tangle, one parting,

The Buddha saves me not; I save myself from dust.

Three parts unseen, seven parts a trace,

Each blade of grass grieves, each blade of grass hears.

Introduction

Written in early July 2018.

They say the rain of June is written full of sorrow. I once did not understand……

items.title: I Am Here
items.content_html: Waiting, waiting for the wind, waiting for the rain, waiting for you, waiting for him, waiting for this world.

items.title: 我在
items.content_html: 等， 等风， 等雨， 等你， 等他， 等这视界。
